ann_latency_pct.real: partial: real LLM-call latencies (36 answer-study calls), not ANN latencies; real ANN percentiles pending (hnsw_experiment.json stores only a mean ms/query per setting, no per-query values)

ares_ppi.real: partial: no human labels in the pack

answer_correctness.real: partial: no TP/FP/FN vs gold and no embedding cosine in the pack; judge verdict 1/0.5/0 stands in for the factual part

bertscore.real: partial: token-level greedy matching on 5 real gold/system answer pairs with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 token vectors (a stand-in, NOT roberta-large BERTScore; raw cosines 0.3-0.9, no baseline rescaling); 5 pairs only, no correlation claim

counterfactual_abstention_triplet.real: partial: 3 unanswerable questions stand in for hidden-gold questions (no masked-gold run); answerable accuracy and counterfactual axis are real; lucky-correct not measurable without gold answers

position_sensitivity.real: partial: own small experiment run (n=10, 5 and 10 passages), result is a ceiling-flat curve; the U shape of the paper is shown only as a labelled toy

triple_prf.real: partial: hand-labelled 2-passage audit only; pack has no gold triples, so no benchmark P/R/F1

entity_resolution_f1.real: partial: no gold clusters in the pack; 37 real node pairs hand-labelled by the author (demo, not a benchmark, non-random pairs)

prerequisite_edge_f1.real: partial: small hand-labelled audit, not a benchmark

evidence_triple_recall.real: partial: no gold triples in the pack; G* = edges extracted from a gold passage (proxy)

subgraph_precision.real: partial: no gold triples in the pack; gold-supported = edge extracted from a gold passage (proxy), precision is a lower bound

kgqa_hits_at_k.real: partial: only 10 of 24 questions have a gold answer that is a graph node (lexical who/which rule), so Hits@k has n = 10

kg_groundedness_rate.real: done: claim-vs-KG rule on the real pack (our crude rule, compared with the judges)

stage_latency.real: partial: only the 36 generation-call latencies are real; embedding, vector search, rerank and graph stages were never timed (pending)

throughput_littles_law.real: done: W = the 36 real answer-call latencies (mean 3.71 s, p95 5.14 s); concurrency needed and throughput ceiling computed live. Queue panel is a labelled SIMULATION (Poisson arrivals, FIFO, service resampled from the 36 values); rate limits and real queueing are not in the pack.

agent_steps.real: pending: the pack has no agent loop (arms are single-shot pipelines); only harness LLM-call counts and query-transform counts shown, labelled as proxies

pedagogy_rubric.real: pending: no tutor dialogues or human ratings in the pack

pedagogy_reward_winrate.real: pending: no pedagogy reward model and no tutor-vs-teacher dialogue data in the pack (the answer study is factual QA; its pairwise win rate is an LLM judge between arms, a different measurement)

tutoreval_keypoints.real: partial: real Q&A answers, not tutor dialogues; our rule; real tutor dialogues pending

answer_leakage_rate.real: partial: real Q&A answers, not tutor dialogues; our rule; real tutor dialogues pending

normalized_gain.real: pending: no pre/post data (the classroom study does not exist yet)

cohens_d.real: done: effect sizes of the arm differences on the real per-question scores (n=9, LLM-judged); classroom effect sizes need real students

concept_coverage.real: done: our rule on the real graph, two expected-set definitions
